test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE test_unsorted_{partitions} (a UInt64, b UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % {partitions}
CREATE TABLE t_skew90_uniq (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY if(sipHash64(a) % 10 < 9, 0, 1 + sipHash64(a) % 15)
CREATE TABLE t_skew30_dup (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY if(sipHash64(a) % 10 < 3, 0, 1 + sipHash64(a) % 15)
CREATE TABLE t_all_unique (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % 16
CREATE TABLE t_all_unique_str (a String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % 16
CREATE TABLE t_half_dup (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % 16
CREATE TABLE t_mild_dup (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % 16
CREATE TABLE t_dup_head_uniq_tail (a UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(a) % 16
CREATE TABLE t_lc_nullable (a LowCardinality(Nullable(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() PARTITION BY sipHash64(coalesce(a, '')) % 16
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_{partitions} SELECT number % 100000, number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_{partitions} FINAL
INSERT INTO test_unsorted_{partitions} SELECT number % 100000, number FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE test_unsorted_{partitions} FINAL
INSERT INTO t_skew90_uniq SELECT number FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_skew90_uniq FINAL
INSERT INTO t_skew30_dup SELECT number % 100000 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_skew30_dup FINAL
INSERT INTO t_all_unique SELECT number FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_all_unique FINAL
INSERT INTO t_all_unique_str SELECT concat(toString(number), repeat('x', 80)) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_all_unique_str FINAL
INSERT INTO t_half_dup SELECT number % 15000000 FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_half_dup FINAL
INSERT INTO t_mild_dup SELECT if(number % 8 = 0, number - 1, number) FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_mild_dup FINAL
INSERT INTO t_dup_head_uniq_tail SELECT number % 100000 FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
INSERT INTO t_dup_head_uniq_tail SELECT 10000000 + number FROM numbers_mt(25000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_dup_head_uniq_tail FINAL
INSERT INTO t_lc_nullable SELECT if(number % 16 = 0, NULL, concat('k', toString(number))) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE t_lc_nullable FINAL
